title: Multi-bot in connected mode — server fills bomber slots with personality-mixed bots (close the S141 solo-only gap)
intent: S141 shipped 'multi-bot solo' — 3 bots, one of each personality (hunter / coward / miner), spawned in the local client. S141 notes explicitly scope it: 'Scope: solo profile only. Connected mode keeps the single server-owned bot path (server-side AI doesn't know about local multi-bot).' This means connected-mode worlds with 1 human player still get a single bot opponent — quieter, less varied, no battle-royale energy. This story extends the server side: world config picks a target bomber count (default 4), the server fills empty slots with personality-mixed server-side bots, and each bot's personality is server-driven (snapshot carries it; client decorator from S109 already renders the personality-keyed recipe).
rationale: Source: S141 sprint notes (scope: solo profile only) + `docs/game-design/gameplay-systems.md §6` ('Bot count in multiplayer: when N humans connect to a 4-slot arena, do we fill remaining slots with bots up to a target N+M? Recommendation: yes, fill to 4 total bombers — keeps the round-length consistent. Defer final answer to the network story.'). Network story is here. Connected mode currently feels emptier than solo (1 bot vs 3); this story closes the gap. Pairs with GDP-2026-05-27-001 cross arena (which has 4 spawn cells — natural fit for N=4 multi-bot).
acceptanceHints: Depends on: GDP-022-011 multiplayer Sprint B (server-authoritative bot AI) — SHIPPED S117-S125. S141 multi-bot solo — SHIPPED.
SERVER SIDE (examples/backends/node-world-server kaboom module):
WorldConfig gains `targetBomberCount: 1..4` (default 4) and `botPersonalityMix: 'one-of-each' | 'random' | 'all-hunter' | 'all-coward' | 'all-miner'` (default 'one-of-each').
On world startup + on each round restart, count current human Presence + spawn server-side bots to reach targetBomberCount.
Bot personality assignment per the mix strategy:
one-of-each: cycle through [hunter, coward, miner] in entity-id-ascending order.
random: uniform random per bot at spawn time (seeded by world seed + round number for determinism).
all-X: force every bot to personality X (useful for tournament / playtest modes).

Each bot gets a server-owned recipe seeded from `'bot.' + personality + '.' + bombSerialNumber` so two bots with the same personality look identical-but-distinct (the seed encodes both family + serial).
PROTOCOL:
Snapshot's Presence entity already carries playerId + recipe (S109 + S112). Add `botPersonality: 'hunter'|'coward'|'miner' | null` field (null for human-controlled).
Client decorator (S109 remote-bomber-decorator-system) reads botPersonality if present and applies the matching palette + accessory marker from S139 (ember+antennae / slate+visor / sand+cap).
DROP-IN BEHAVIOUR (preserves the GDP-022-012 Sprint C policy):

Human joins → spectates until next round (existing behaviour). When the new round starts, count human Presence again + adjust bot count → if humans went from 1 to 2, one bot slot is freed up; the server despawns ONE bot at round-restart (lowest-personality-priority or random). If humans went from 2 to 1, one new bot fills the freed slot at next round.
Human leaves → bot fills the slot at next round restart.
CLIENT SIDE:

No new client code needed beyond reading the botPersonality field from snapshot. The S109 remote-bomber-decorator-system already spawns the procbomber tree per Presence; just thread the personality through to the recipe resolver.
Minimap markers: bots show their personality-palette colour. Players show their recipe.palette.head colour (existing).

HUD bottom-left tally line: in connected mode with multi-bot, the existing 'bot' column from S100 needs to handle multiple bots. Either tally-per-bot or tally-aggregated; recommendation: aggregate (one column 'bots' for total bot wins) — simpler HUD.

BALANCE: 4-bomber rounds in connected mode play meaningfully different from 2-bomber rounds (more chains, more chaos, faster pickup drops as more soft blocks destroyed). Bot-vs-bot regression test extended: run a 4-bot (1 of each + 1 random) round; must still resolve within budget.
DETERMINISM: server's RNG seeds personality assignment + bot recipe; same world seed + same human-Presence sequence → same bot lineup.
ACCEPTANCE PLAYTEST:

One tab joins /?project=kaboom-crew&world=test&profile=connected on a 4-spawn arena (cross from GDP-2026-05-27-001) → server fills 3 bot slots with hunter + coward + miner (one of each). Tab sees 4 distinct bombers — self + 3 personality-mixed bots.
Two tabs join the same world → server has 2 humans + 2 bots (target 4). Bots are hunter + coward (drop miner since hunter+coward is the most behaviourally-distinct pair).
Three tabs join → 3 humans + 1 bot (hunter).
Four tabs join → 4 humans + 0 bots. No spawn-cell starvation.
Five tabs would request join → spectator queue (per GDP-022-012 spectate-until-next-round rule).
EDGE CASES:
All humans leave mid-round → server keeps the round going with remaining bots. Round-resolve fires when one bot left; auto-restart spawns the target bomber count again.

No spawn cells available (4 humans on a 2-spawn arena): the smaller arena variants (default = 2 spawn, plaza = 2 spawn, pit = 2 spawn) cap bomber count at spawn count. Player 3-4 enter spectator queue.
OUT OF SCOPE:
Per-personality difficulty tuning in multiplayer (single difficulty across all server bots in v1).
Saboteur / Greedy / Guard / Monster personality variants from `notes/DynaBomber.md §13.1`. The 3-personality set stays.
Bot disconnect/reconnect (bots are server-owned, no client connection state).
Team-up modes (humans + bots vs other humans + bots). Free-for-all stays the rule.
Configurable bot count via URL (server-config only for v1).
